verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's own materials cover O-1A, TN, E-3, E-2 (eligibility quiz and treaty-country guide) and the EB-1A and EB-2 NIW green-card paths. It also offers a side-by-side pathway comparison and TN guidance on whether a pathway should stand alone or sit beside another option. H-1B appears only indirectly, through an H-4 dependent guide that references the principal H-1B holder, and cap-exempt routes are never mentioned. Missing for 10: a dedicated H-1B pathway page, any coverage of cap-exempt H-1B routes, founder-specific selection guidance across the full menu, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation
